plugins.why: 5 hosted MCP servers load in every session at user scope. At project scope they load only in a repo that deploys to Cloudflare. A single plugin MCP server cannot be disabled on its own, so scope is the only lever. See docs/mcp/disabling-servers.md.
plugins.use_when: repo deploys to Cloudflare (Workers, Pages, R2, D1)

plugins.why: hosted MCP bridge, same scope reason as cloudflare.
